specs.Other Special Features of the Product: 2 Way Audio, Built In Light, HD Resolution, Motion Sensor, Night Vision

features: 1080P HD Panoramic View with 360° Coverage – This WiFi bulb dome camera captures crystal-clear video in 1080P resolution with its wide-angle panoramic lens. The 360° field of view ensures there are no blind spots, making it ideal for complete coverage of your living room, office, shop, or bedroom with a single device.

Easy Bulb Socket Installation – No Wiring Needed – Designed for hassle-free setup, this camera simply screws into a standard E27 bulb holder like a normal light bulb. No additional wiring, drilling, or professional help required. Just power it on, connect to WiFi, and manage everything easily from your smartphone app.

Full-Color Night Vision with Dual Light Technology – Equipped with both infrared sensors and bright LED lights, this camera provides excellent visibility even in complete darkness. Choose between traditional black & white night vision or full-color night vision mode for enhanced clarity, ensuring you never miss important details at night.

Smart Motion Detection with Instant Mobile Alerts – The advanced motion detection system instantly tracks any suspicious movement and sends real-time alerts to your smartphone. Whether you’re at home, at work, or traveling, you’ll always stay updated and in full control of your security.

Two-Way Audio for Real-Time Communication – Featuring a built-in microphone and speaker, the WiFi bulb dome camera allows you to talk and listen through your smartphone app. Greet family members, instruct delivery personnel, or even deter unwanted visitors with live voice interaction from anywhere in the world.
